objective: Test whether regularized conditional-covariance SAVE geometry, alone or combined with mean contrasts, provides one continuous OI metric that retains linear and nonlinear best-head ranking.

target_moment_geometry.preconditioner: rank-8 pooled within-target-cell residual scaling and energetic-direction deflation
target_moment_geometry.global_standardization: symmetric eigendecomposition whitening with relative floor 1e-6 and absolute floor 1e-12
target_moment_geometry.mean_moment: sum_h p_h mu_h mu_h^T in the whitened residual space
target_moment_geometry.save_moment: sum_h p_h (I - Sigma_h)^2 in the whitened residual space
target_moment_geometry.combination: mean and SAVE moment matrices are independently trace-normalized and added with fixed equal weight
target_moment_geometry.projection: top positive eigenvectors, capped at rank 8, with deterministic column signs
target_moment_geometry.leakage: all cells, scaling, covariance, whitening, and projection state are fitted within each cross-fit training fold

reference_heads.envelope: maximum held-out R2 across the four frozen heads on observed features

reference_performance_gate.interpretation: Aggregate claims require every per-panel performance floor and both nonlinear-head win counts to pass.

axis_metrics.quality_at_fixed_nuisance: Primary monotonic ranking estimand within each nuisance level.
axis_metrics.nuisance_at_fixed_quality: Secondary sensitivity estimand within each quality level.

primary_contrasts: mean-plus-SAVE versus full Fisher, observed OI, and the linear probe
mean-plus-SAVE versus the privileged quadratic-lift ceiling
primary_metrics: panel and fixed-nuisance quality Spearman with the best-head envelope
negative actual-loss and negative loss-ratio Spearman
tie_rule: Average envelope performance across candidates tied at absolute tolerance 1e-12 for the maximum selector score.
scope: Exploratory synthetic development evidence; no production or generalization claim.
